card.name: Words just before "develop"
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "the", "from" or "must" right before a form of "develop" or "learn". The next word is expected to be develop, development or a similar growth verb.

modes.label: "to" before develop
modes.description: The word "to" after likely, fail, or skill, where "develop" or "learn" comes next.
modes.example: might be less likely<< to>> develop allergic conditions because of how their parents

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "the", "from", or "language" that come just before "development" or "developing".
modes.example: they can affect the speech and<< language>> development of younger children.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write develop, developing or development as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says develop or development, as in children developing skills or allergies.
